body_edits.diff: Integrate the recently published (July 2021) ["Guidelines on Minimum Standards for Developer Verification of Software"](https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2021/07/13/Developer%20Verification%20of%20Software.pdf) from NIST.

Integrate the recently published (July 2021) ["Guidelines on Minimum Standards for Developer Verification of Software"](https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2021/07/13/Developer%20Verification%20of%20Software.pdf) from NIST.

[NIST Misses Opportunity With New 'Minimum Standard' for Software Security Testing](https://www.darkreading.com/edge-articles/nist-misses-opportunity-with-new-minimum-standard-for-software-security-testing)
[It's High Time for a Security Scoring System for Applications and Open Source Libraries](https://www.darkreading.com/application-security/it-s-high-time-for-a-security-scoring-system-for-applications-and-open-source-libraries)
[Video of Public Hearing from Jeff Williams](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/planetlevel_appsec-owasp-nist-activity-6822747706050527232-PfX-/)

Confirm the integration of the recently published (July 2021) ["Guidelines on Minimum Standards for Developer Verification of Software"](https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2021/07/13/Developer%20Verification%20of%20Software.pdf) from NIST, specifically their  "_Recommended Minimum Standard for Developer Testing_":

- [ ] Threat Modeling
- [ ] Automated Testing
- [ ] Code-Based, or Static, Analysis
- [ ] Review for Hardcoded Secrets
- [ ] Run with Language-Provided Checks and Protection
- [ ] Black Box Test Cases
- [ ] Code-Based Test Cases
- [ ] Historical Test Cases
- [ ] Fuzzing
- [ ] Web Application Scanning
- [ ] Check Included Software Components
